$comment: THE model registry. §6.2.6: a model id appears in exactly one file. This is JSON rather than TypeScript so the .mjs bake-off harness reads the same source as the app — two registries in two languages is the duplication the rule forbids, spelled differently. scripts/guards/check-model-ids.mjs enforces it.
$prices_comment: Nano-USD per token, and the minimum cacheable prefix in tokens. The minimum is load-bearing: a prefix below it silently does not cache — no error, no warning, just a bill that does not fall. Haiku's 4096 is four times Sonnet's, which is why the cheaper model is not automatically the cheaper choice.
$thinking_comment: Sonnet 5 accepts thinking {type:'disabled'} and REJECTS budget_tokens with a 400, so pinning it off is the only way to stop thinking eating the reply budget (D-014). Sampling parameters (temperature/top_p/top_k) are also removed on Sonnet 5 and 400.
